question: What do we carry our books in when we go to school? 🎒
explanation: Super! We keep our books safe in our school bag! 🎒
hint: We wear it on our shoulders.

question: Which big yellow vehicle takes many kids to school? 🚌
explanation: Great job! The school bus picks up many children! 🚌
hint: It has many seats and big wheels.

question: What sound does the school bus horn make? 🔊
explanation: Awesome! The bus goes beep beep to tell us it is here! 🚍
hint: Cars also make this sound.

question: Who do we hold hands with when we walk to school? 🤝
explanation: Perfect! Parents hold our hands to keep us safe! 🤝
hint: They are the elders in our family.

question: What do we see growing tall near the road? 🌳
explanation: Super! Tall trees grow along the road and give us shade! 🌳
hint: They have green leaves.

question: Who sings sweetly on the tree branches? 🐦
explanation: Beautiful! Little birds sing happily in the morning! 🐦
hint: They have feathers and wings.

question: What do we bring to eat during the break? 🍱
explanation: Yummy! We bring tasty food in our lunchbox! 🍱
hint: We open it when we feel hungry.

question: What is the painted safe path to cross the road? 🦓
explanation: Fantastic! A zebra crossing keeps us safe when walking! 🦓
hint: It has black and white stripes.

question: What does the red traffic light mean? 🛑
explanation: Great job! Red means we must stop and wait! 🛑
hint: It is the very top color.

question: What does the green traffic light mean? 🟢
explanation: Awesome! Green means the road is clear to go! 🟢
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: What do we ride with two wheels to go to school? 🚲
explanation: Super! We pedal our bicycle to move forward! 🚲
hint: You use your feet to pedal.

question: What do we wear on our feet to walk? 👟
explanation: Perfect! Shoes protect our feet on the road! 👟
hint: We wear socks inside them.

question: What animal might we see sleeping near a shop? 🐕
explanation: Great! Friendly dogs often rest near the road! 🐕
hint: It says bow-wow.

question: What is bright and shines in the morning sky? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The golden sun wakes us up for school! ☀️
hint: It is very hot and yellow.

question: Who stands on the road to help traffic? 👮
explanation: Super! The traffic police keeps all cars safe! 👮
hint: They wear a special uniform and whistle.

question: What flies from flower to flower? 🦋
explanation: Beautiful! Butterflies are very colorful and pretty! 🦋
hint: It has colorful wings.

question: What do we say to Mom and Dad before leaving? 👋
explanation: Great job! We wave goodbye when we leave for school! 👋
hint: We say this when we go away.

question: Who do we meet at the school gate? 👧
explanation: Awesome! We meet our happy friends at school! 👧
hint: We play and study with them.

question: What do we carry our drinking water in? 💧
explanation: Super! A water bottle keeps us hydrated! 💧
hint: It has a cap and holds liquid.

question: What covers our head when it is sunny outside? 🧢
explanation: Perfect! A cap keeps the bright sun out of our eyes! 🧢
hint: We wear it on top of our hair.

question: What rings loudly when school starts? 🔔
explanation: Great! The school bell tells us to go to class! 🔔
hint: It goes tring-tring.

question: What do we see floating high in the sky? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Fluffy white clouds look like cotton candy! ☁️
hint: They can bring rain.

question: How do we feel when we see our friends? 😊
explanation: Super! Seeing our friends makes us smile big! 😊
hint: We show our teeth and smile.

question: What three-wheeled vehicle can take us to school? 🛺
explanation: Great job! An auto rickshaw has three wheels and is fun! 🛺
hint: It is yellow and green.

question: What do we use to stay dry in the rain? ☂️
explanation: Perfect! An umbrella pops open to stop the rain! ☂️
hint: We hold it over our heads.

question: What do we say to our teacher in the morning? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! Good morning is a polite way to greet! 🌅
hint: We say this when the sun comes up.

question: What do we do with our hands to say hello? 👋
explanation: Super! We wave our hands high to say a happy hello! 👋
hint: We move our hand side to side.

question: What do we put around our neck to stay warm? 🧣
explanation: Great! A scarf is soft and keeps us cozy in winter! 🧣
hint: It is long and made of wool.

question: What do we look at to cross the road safely? 👀
explanation: Perfect! We always check both sides before crossing! 👀
hint: We use our eyes to check for cars.

question: What place sells things on the side of the road? 🏬
explanation: Awesome! Shops sell many fun and useful things! 🏬
hint: We buy things here with money.

question: What animal gives milk and says moo? 🐄
explanation: Super! We might see a gentle cow walking by the road! 🐄
hint: It eats grass and gives milk.

question: What helps a bicycle go fast? 🚴
explanation: Great job! Pushing the pedals makes the wheels turn! 🚴
hint: We push them with our feet.

question: What do we find in a puddle after it rains? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Rainwater makes fun splashy puddles! 💧
hint: It is wet and clear.

question: What color are the leaves on most trees? 🍃
explanation: Perfect! Green leaves look beautiful on our way to school! 🍃
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: Who drives the big school bus? 👨‍✈️
explanation: Super! The bus driver takes us safely to school! 👨‍✈️
hint: He steers the big wheel.

question: What do we write with in our notebook? ✏️
explanation: Great! We use a pencil to write neat letters! ✏️
hint: It has an eraser on top.

question: What tells us our name and class at school? 🪪
explanation: Awesome! Our ID card shows who we are! 🪪
hint: We wear it around our neck.

question: What is the very first meal of the day? 🥣
explanation: Perfect! Breakfast gives us energy for school! 🥣
hint: We eat this before we leave the house.

question: What do we use to wipe our face? 🤧
explanation: Super! A hanky keeps us neat and clean! 🤧
hint: It is a small piece of cloth.

question: Who checks our teeth near the road? 🦷
explanation: Great job! A dentist keeps our smile bright and healthy! 🦷
hint: We might see their clinic on the way.

question: What animal runs fast and catches mice? 🐈
explanation: Awesome! Cute cats sometimes sit on walls near houses! 🐈
hint: It says meow.

question: What do we put inside our shoes? 🧦
explanation: Perfect! Soft socks make our shoes feel comfortable! 🧦
hint: They keep our toes warm.

question: What fast vehicle has four wheels? 🚗
explanation: Super! A car drives smoothly on the road! 🚗
hint: It honks its horn.

question: What do we use to comb our hair? 🪮
explanation: Great! A comb makes our hair look very neat! 🪮
hint: We use it on our head.

question: What do we see people reading at the bus stop? 📰
explanation: Awesome! Newspapers tell us news from all over! 📰
hint: It is made of big paper.

question: What do we use to color our drawings? 🖍️
explanation: Perfect! Crayons make our pictures bright and fun! 🖍️
hint: They come in many colors.

question: What insect is busy making honey? 🐝
explanation: Super! Bees buzz around flowers on our way! 🐝
hint: It goes buzz-buzz.

question: Where do we wait for the school bus? 🚏
explanation: Great job! We stand safely at the bus stop! 🚏
hint: There is a sign board here.

question: What do we wear to keep our clothes clean at lunch? 🎽
explanation: Awesome! A bib or napkin keeps food off our uniform! 🎽
hint: We tuck it under our chin.

question: How do we walk when we are happy? 🚶
explanation: Perfect! Skipping and hopping is a joyful way to go! 🚶
hint: It is like a bouncy walk.
